item.title: Visible signal of generational investment
item.description: The Star Class was among the iconic Olympic events, attracting the best of the best to challenge others in this 22-foot 9-inch two-person keelboat. But its era, which began in 1932, came to an end in 2012 as the Olympic equipment shifted toward speedier boats. As racing the Star is not inexpensive, this shift meant many people, supported by their national federations, were leaving the Class. However, over a decade later, activity remains strong with 75 teams at the 99th Bacardi Cup in Miami, FL.

item.title: Eight Bells: Guus Bierman
item.description: Guus Bierman, founder of Contender Sailcloth, passed away peacefully on March 2, 2026. He was 87 years of age. Guus was a passionate sailor and yachtsman, for whom sailing always connected the dots in life. Equally important, he was an internationally minded pioneer, always alert to any opportunity and an excellent salesman and businessman. If you had the chance to meet him, you would immediately recognize that this man had “sailcloth in his stomach,” as Guus would say. - Full report

item.title: Significant safety law being proposed
item.description: In the USA, all children under 13 years old are required to wear a U.S. Coast Guard-approved life jacket while on a moving recreational vessel, a wearable life jacket must be on board for each person, and all vessels must carry at least one throwable device. item.title: Full bar at Bacardi bash
item.description: The 2026 Bacardi Cup is firing on all cylinders as 175 boats in five classes slice up Biscayne Bay in Miami, FL. item.title: Giving birth to something new
item.description: When it became necessary to cancel the 2026 San Diego to Puerto Vallarta Race just days before the start, host San Diego Yacht Club called an audible.
